one_liner: SendGrid has a broad REST v3 API with API-key Bearer auth; access is via a 60-day free trial (100 emails/day), and only community MCP servers were found.
auth_notes: Bearer API keys created in the console with scoped permissions; no OAuth documented.
access_notes: New accounts get a 60-day trial with 100 emails/day for Email API, no credit card required. After the trial, email send stops unless a paid plan is chosen. The sendgrid.com/en-us/free page mentions a 'free plan' loosely, but the support article describes new accounts as trial-only.
blocker_notes: A 60-day trial is long enough to build and test. Customers use their own API keys. The vendor MCP status was not verifiable from the provided pages.

evidence.quote: To use an API key, include an `Authorization` header with the value `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>` in your request.
